reports.title: Verisk Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: The company's financial outlook for 2026 remains unchanged and is as follows:

Low | High
Total revenue | 3,190 | 3,240
Adjusted EBITDA | 1,790 | 1,830
Adjusted EBITDA margin | 56.0 | 56.5
Diluted adjusted EPS | 7.45 | 7.75
Tax rate | 23.0 | 26.0
Capital expenditures | 260 | 280
Fixed asset depreciation & amortization | 270 | 290
Intangible amortization | 60 | 60
Interest expense | 190 | 200
Dividend per share | 2.00 | 2.00

desk.headline: Revenue up 5% to $809m, adjusted EPS $1.96 beat; 2026 outlook kept
results: Revenue rose 5.3% to $809m, or 7.4% on an organic constant-currency basis, with subscriptions up 8.2%.
Adjusted EBITDA grew 7% to $459m and the margin widened to 56.7% from 55.8%.
Adjusted EPS rose 14% to $1.96, ahead of the $1.92 estimate, helped by a lower share count; GAAP net income fell 2.8% on investment losses and higher interest.
Free cash flow dropped 40.5% to $200m on higher interest and tax payments and slower collections.
A $100m buyback was done in the quarter ($1.9bn so far this year) and the 50c quarterly dividend is up 11%.

guidance.summary: Verisk kept its 2026 outlook unchanged: revenue of $3.19-3.24bn, adjusted EBITDA of $1.79-1.83bn (56-56.5% margin) and adjusted EPS of $7.45-7.75.

points: Management expects 2026 to land near the middle of the guidance ranges, citing longer sales cycles and a quiet weather year.
The stronger transactional revenue in Q3 is not expected to repeat in Q4.
Insurers are adopting new AI-based products steadily but cautiously; several new tools added clients this year.
Small contractors and adjusters (about 10% of revenue) are under pressure and may weigh a little into early 2027.
The AccuLynx deal still needs regulatory clearance and is not certain to close; margins are expected to widen 0.25-0.75 pts a year.
